αἰδοίη: αἰδοῖος — held in respect, revered; fem. nom. sg.
αἰπὺ: αἰπύς — steep, sheer; adj., neut. acc. sg., agreeing with ὄρος

αἴθοπα: αἴθοψ — fire-faced, sparkling (of wine, lit. αἴθω ’burn’ + ὤψ ’face’); masc. acc. sg.
αἶψ: αἶψα — quickly, swiftly; adv., elided (αἶψ’ = αἶψα)

αὐτὰρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)

αὖ: αὖ — again, in turn, back; adv., shorter form of αὖτε

γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle

δύσετό: δύω/δύνω — sink, set (of the sun); aor. mid. 3 sg., unaugmented
δώματ: δῶμα — house, home; neut. acc. pl., elided (δώματ’ = δώματα)
δῖος: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; masc. nom. sg., epithet of heroes (= fem. δῖα)
δῶμα: δῶμα — house, hall, dwelling; acc. sg.

θαλάμοιο: θάλαμος — chamber, room; masc. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
θεοῦ: θεός — god; masc. gen. sg., genitive with a verb of hearing · also genitive governed by a preposition (ἄνευ θεοῦ ’without a god’)
θεόφιν: θεός — god; dat./instr. pl., epic suffix -φι(ν) (θεόφιν = θεοῖς): ’to/by the gods’ (θεόφιν μήστωρ ἀτάλαντος ’a counselor the equal of the gods’)
θοῆς: θοός — swift, quick; fem. gen. sg.
θυμός: θυμός — heart, spirit; masc. nom. sg.
θυράων: θύρα — door; fem. gen. pl., epic -άων (= Attic θυρῶν)

καρπαλίμως: καρπάλιμος — swift, nimble; adv. καρπαλίμως: ’swiftly, nimbly’
κατ: κατά (elided κατ’) — down from, throughout; + gen./acc. · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (κατ’ … ἕζετο = κατέζετο ’sat down’)

κεχάροιτο: χαίρω — rejoice; perf. opt. 3 sg., reduplicated (κεχάροιτο), potential: ’would rejoice’
κρέ: κρέας — meat, flesh; neut. acc. pl., elided (κρέ’ = κρέα)
λαῶν: λαός — people, host; masc. gen. pl., governed by ἄνασσε ’was lord over’
λῦσεν: λύω — loose, dissolve, break up; aor. 3 sg.
μάλα: μάλα — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
μέλαιναν: μέλας — black, dark; fem. acc. sg., agreeing with κῆρα · also agreeing with νῆα (θοὴν ἀνὰ νῆα μέλαιναν ’the swift black ship’)
μένος: μένος — force, might, spirit, drive; neut. acc. sg. · also neut. nom. sg., subject (μένος … ἐνέστακται ’his force has been instilled’)
μήστωρ: μήστωρ — counselor, adviser, one who devises; masc. nom. sg. (θεόφιν μήστωρ ἀτάλαντος ’a counselor the equal of the gods’)
μεγαθύμου: μεγάθυμος — great-hearted, high-spirited; masc. gen. sg.
μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’
μοῖραν: μοῖρα — due share, what is fitting, portion, fate; fem. acc. sg. (κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’)
μύθων: μῦθος — speech, word, thing said (not yet ’myth’ in Homer); gen. pl.
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ
μῆρ: μηρός (pl. μῆρα) — thigh; sacrificial thigh-piece wrapped in fat and burned to a god; neut. acc. pl., elided (μῆρ’ = μῆρα)
νέοι: νέος — young, new; masc. nom. pl.
νέστορ: Νέστωρ — Nestor, king of Pylos; masc. voc. sg.
νέστωρ: Νέστωρ — Nestor, king of Pylos; masc. nom. sg.
νεστορίδης: Νεστορίδης — son of Nestor (patronymic); masc. nom. sg.
νηὸς: ναῦς — ship; gen. sg., epic νηός (= Attic νεώς)
νῆα: ναῦς — ship; acc. sg., epic νῆα
οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him’ (very common) · also ὁ, ἡ, τό ’he, she, it’, masc. nom. pl. ’they’ (e.g. οἱ μὲν … οἱ δέ ’some … others’)
οἵ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl.
οἷα: οἷος — such as, of what kind; neut. acc. pl., relative: ’such (things) as’
οἷς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (possessive) — his own, her own; masc./neut. dat. pl.: ’his own’ (μετὰ οἷς ἑτάροισι ’among his own companions’)
οὐκ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a vowel with smooth breathing (οὐχ before a rough breathing)
οὖρος: οὖρος — a fair wind, favorable wind; masc. nom. sg.
πάντα: πᾶς — all, every; neut. nom./acc. pl.
πάντας: πᾶς — all, every; masc. acc. pl.
πάντες: πᾶς — all, every; masc. nom. pl.
πάσαντο: πατέομαι — taste, partake of; aor. mid. 3 pl., unaugmented: ’they tasted’
παρ: παρά (elided παρ’) — beside, among; + dat. · also + gen., ’from, from the side of’ (παρ’ Ἴλου ’from Ilus’) · also + acc., of motion, ’past, along, beside’ (παρ’ Μίμαντα ’past Mimas’)
παρίστατο: παρίσταμαι — stand beside, stand by; impf. 3 sg.: ‘stood by’
παρὰ: παρά — beside, along, from; prep. + dat./acc./gen. · also used as an adverb with no case expressed: ’beside, alongside’ (παρὰ … ἐτάνυσσε τράπεζαν ’drew a table up beside (them)’)
παῖδα: παῖς — child, son, daughter; masc./fem. acc. sg.
παῖδες: παῖς — child, son; masc. nom. pl.
πεισίστρατος: Πεισίστρατος — Peisistratus, son of Nestor; masc. nom. sg.
περικαλλέα: περικαλλής — very beautiful; fem. acc. sg., epic uncontracted (= Attic περικαλλῆ) · also neut. nom./acc. pl., agreeing with a neuter plural noun: ’very beautiful’ (ἔργα ... περικαλλέα ’very beautiful works, fine handiwork’)
περὶ: περί — around, about; prep. + gen.: ’superior to, beyond’; also as adv.: ’exceedingly, surpassingly’ · also prep. + gen. in its plain sense ’about, concerning’ (περὶ πατρός ’about his father’) · also preverb in tmesis · + dat. · also + acc., of place, ’around, about’ (περὶ ἄστυ ’around the city’)
πολλὰ: πολύς — much, many; neut. acc. pl.: ’many things, greatly’
ποτὶ: πρός — to, toward, against; prep., epic ποτί, here as preverb in tmesis (ποτὶ … βάλε = προσέβαλε) · also a plain preposition + acc., no tmesis: ποτὶ τοῖχον ’against the wall’ · also + dat. ‘against’
προθύροιο: πρόθυρον — forecourt, gateway before the house-door; neut. gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -ου)
προπάροιθε: προπάροιθε — before, in front of; adv./prep. + gen.
πρώτιστα: πρώτιστος — first of all (epic double superlative of πρῶτος); neut. acc. pl. used adverbially: ’first of all’
πρὶν: πρίν — before, until; adv./conj., + inf. (grave, mid-clause form) · also τὸ πρίν, substantivized with the article: ‘formerly, at first’, no infinitive
πτολίεθρον: πτολίεθρον — citadel, city; neut. acc. sg., epic lengthened by-form of πόλις
πόσιος: πόσις — drinking; gen. sg. (abstract noun, distinct from πόσις ’husband’)
πύλου: Πύλος — Pylos, city in the Peloponnese, home of Nestor; gen. sg.
πὰρ: παρά (apocope πάρ, functioning as an adverb) — beside, alongside; adv.
πᾶσαι: πᾶς — all, every; fem. nom. pl.
σκιόωντό: σκιάω (also σκιόω) — cast a shadow, grow dark; impf. mid. 3 pl., epic diectasis (= Attic ἐσκιοῦντο)
σκῆπτρον: σκῆπτρον — staff, sceptre (badge of the right to speak); neut. acc. sg.
σπλάγχνα: σπλάγχνον — mostly pl. σπλάγχνα, the inner organs (heart, liver, etc.), entrails, tasted first at a sacrifice; neut. nom./acc. pl.
σῖτον: σῖτος — bread, grain, the staple of a meal; acc. sg.
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a standing fact · after οὔ νυ perhaps τοι ’to you’ · also in a question, an expressive epic τε with no connective force, giving a note of doubt or wonder (πῶς τε ...; ’how, pray...?’)
τάχιστα: ταχύς — quick, swift; superl. neut. acc. pl. as adv. τάχιστα: ’most quickly’
τέκε: τίκτω — bear, beget; aor. 3 sg., no augment (= ἔτεκε)
ταμίη: ταμίη — housekeeper, stewardess, woman with charge of the stores (Attic ταμία, Ionic η for α); nom. sg.
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τηλέμαχον: Τηλέμαχος — Telemachus, son of Odysseus; masc. acc. sg.
τηλέμαχος: Τηλέμαχος — Telemachus, son of Odysseus; nom. sg.
τηλεμάχου: Τηλέμαχος — Telemachus, son of Odysseus; masc. gen. sg.
τηλεμάχῳ: Τηλέμαχος — Telemachus, son of Odysseus; masc. dat. sg.
τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart

τοῖς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’to/among them’
τοῖσι: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’to/among them’
τοῦ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. gen. sg. ’of him, that one’
τότ: τότε — then, at that time; adv., elided (τότ’ = τότε)
τόφρα: τόφρα — so long, meanwhile; adv., correlative with ἕως ’until’
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg. ’him’
τὼ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. dual: ’the two of them’
τῆς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun); fem. gen. sg.
υἷες: υἱός — son; masc. nom. pl., epic υἷες (= Attic υἱεῖς)
φάνη: φαίνω — show; aor. pass. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἐφάνη): ’appeared’
φέρων: φέρω — carry, bear; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’carrying’
φίλα: φίλος — dear, one’s own; neut. acc. pl. used adverbially with φρονέω: ’with friendly thoughts, kindly’
φᾶρος: φᾶρος — large cloth, robe, web; neut. acc. sg.
χέρνιβα: χέρνιψ — water for washing the hands (χείρ + νίζω); acc. sg.
χερσίν: χείρ — hand; fem. dat. pl., ν-movable
ἀγακλυτὰ: ἀγακλυτός — very renowned, glorious; neut. nom./acc. pl.
ἀγλαὸν: ἀγλαός — splendid, radiant, bright; masc./neut. acc. sg.
ἀγυιαί: ἀγυιά — street, road (in a city); fem. nom. pl.
ἀθήνη: Ἀθήνη — Athena, goddess of wisdom and war; nom. sg.
ἀθήνην: Ἀθήνη — Athena, goddess of wisdom and war; acc. sg.
ἀθανάτοισιν: ἀθάνατος — immortal, deathless; masc. dat. pl., epic (= Attic -οις)
ἀμφ: ἀμφί (elided ἀμφ’) — around, about, concerning; + dat. · also + acc., ’around, with, accompanying’ (ἀμφ’ Ὀδυσῆα ’with, around Odysseus’)
ἀμφὶ: ἀμφί — on both sides, around, about; prep./adv.
ἀμφὶς: ἀμφίς — apart, on both sides, around; adverb
ἀνέρες: ἀνήρ — man; masc. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἄνδρες)

ἀτάλαντος: ἀτάλαντος — equal (in weight), a match for; masc. nom. sg., + dat.: ’equal to’ (θεόφιν ... ἀτάλαντος ’equal to the gods’)
ἀτὰρ: ἀτάρ — but, and; epic conj. (by-form of αὐτάρ)
ἀχαιῶν: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; gen. pl.

ἄγε: ἄγε — come now!; interjectional imper. of ἄγω, 2 sg.
ἄλλοι: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. pl.

ἄρα: ἄρα — so, as it turned out, then; inferential particle
ἐίσης: ἴσος (epic ἐίσος, fem. ἐίση) — equal; of a ship, well-balanced; fem. gen. sg.; exact sense uncertain (’equal on both sides’, or other proposals)

ἐλθόντες: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. part. masc. nom. pl.: ’having come’
ἐλθὼν: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’having come’
ἐμοί: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg., accented (non-enclitic emphatic): ’to me’
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat.
ἐξ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐξ … ἕντο = ἐξέντο, from ἐξίημι ’send out, put away (desire)’)

ἐσθλοὶ: ἐσθλός — good, noble, brave; masc. nom. pl.
ἑτάρους: ἕταρος — companion (by-form of ἑταῖρος); acc. pl.
ἔκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; prep. + gen., placed after its pronoun with anastrophe: τοῦ ... ἔκ = ἐκ τοῦ ’from him’ · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἔκ … ὀνόμαζε = ἐξωνόμαζε ’called by name’)
ἔνθα: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also used relatively, continuing a clause: ’where’ (ἔνθα περ ’in the very place where, just where’)
ἔπειθ: ἔπειτα — then, thereafter; adv., elided (ἔπειθ’ = ἔπειτα before a rough breathing)
ἔπειτ: ἔπειτα (elided ἔπειτ’) — then, next, after that
ἔπι: ἐπί — on, upon, over; prep. + dat., placed after its noun with anastrophe: ἑοῖς ἔπι ’upon his own (possessions)’ · also + gen., postpositive with anastrophe, of direction: ’toward’ (νήσου ἔπι Ψυρίης ’toward the island of Psyria’) · also as adverb with no case expressed, intensifying repetition: ’besides, again’ (ἔπι δεύτερον αὖτις ’a second time, once more’)
ἔρον: ἔρος — desire, longing (= ἔρως); acc. sg.
ἔσαν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 pl., epic (= Attic ἦσαν)
ἔφαθ: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid. (ἔφατο, elided ἔφαθ’, τ>θ before rough breathing)
ἔχον: ἔχω — have, hold, keep to; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= εἶχον)
ἔχοντες: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. nom. pl.
ἔχων: ἔχω — have, hold; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’holding’
ἕδρας: ἕδρα — seat, session, company seated together; fem. acc. pl.
ἕντο: ἵημι — send, let go; mid. put away (from oneself); aor. 3 pl. mid., in tmesis with ἐξ: ’they put away (desire)’
ἕταροι: ἑταῖρος — companion, comrade; masc. nom. pl., epic by-form ἕταροι (= ἑταῖροι)
ἠγερέθοντο: ἀγείρω — gather, assemble; impf. pass. 3 pl., epic -εθ- formation (= Attic ἠγείροντο)
ἠριγένεια: ἠριγένεια — early-born; fem. nom. sg., epithet of Dawn
ἠώς: ἠώς — dawn; fem. nom. sg. (personified Ἠώς, Attic Ἕως)
ἤδη: ἤδη — now, already, at once; adv.
ἥ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., fem. nom. sg. · also ὁ, ἡ, τό (personal/demonstrative pronoun): she; fem. nom. sg. (ἥ γε ’she indeed’, of the ship)
ἥρως: ἥρως — hero, man of standing; masc. nom. sg.
ἦ: ἦ — truly, verily; affirming particle · also interrogative particle introducing an earnest question · also = ἤ ’or’, in the correlative ἠέ … ἦ ’whether … or’ · also ἠμί — say, speak; unaugmented aor./impf. 3 sg. (= ἔφη), closing or introducing direct speech: ’he/she said’ (ἦ ῥα ’so he said’)
ἦλθον: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. 3 pl.: ’they came’ · also aor. 1 sg. (the same ending serves both persons): ’I have come’
ἦμος: ἦμος — when, at the time when; temporal conj.
ἦρχε: ἄρχω — begin, rule; impf. 3 sg., + gen. ’began (the speaking)’ · also ’go first, lead the way’ (no gen.): ἦρχε δ’ Ἀθήνη ’and Athena went first, led the way’
ἰὼν: εἶμι — go; pres. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’going’
ἱππότα: ἱππότης — horseman, charioteer (epithet of Nestor); masc. nom. sg., old form in short -α
ἴτω: εἶμι — go; pres. imper. 3 sg.: ’let her go’
ἵκοντο: ἱκνέομαι — come, arrive at, reach; aor. 3 pl.; with short ι (by metre) unaugmented; where the metre makes the ι long, augmented (the spelling cannot show it)
ἵν: ἵνα — so that, in order that; conj., elided (ἵν’ = ἵνα)
ἵνα: ἵνα — so that, in order that; + subj. · also + opt. after a past tense
ἷξον: ἵκω — come, arrive, reach; aor. 3 pl.: ’they came’ (+ acc. of place reached, with or without a preposition)
ὀστέα: ὀστέον — bone; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὀστᾶ)
ὁ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. sg.
ὁδοῖο: ὁδός — road, way, journey; gen. sg., epic -οιο (= Attic -οῦ)
ὄφρ: ὄφρα (elided ὄφρ’) — so that, in order that; epic (= Attic ἵνα); + subj. · also temporal, ’as long as, while’ + indicative (ὄφρ’ ἔτι κεῖνος ἀνὴρ ἐπιδήμιος ἦεν ’as long as that man was still at home’) · also ’while’ + ἄν and subj.
ὄφρα: ὄφρα — so that, in order that; epic (= Attic ἵνα); + subj. · also temporal, ’until’, + indic. (ὄφρα ... βάλε): marking the point an action ceases · also temporal + subj. with κε, correlative with τόφρα: ’as long as, until’ (ὄφρα κε κείνη τοῦτον ἔχῃ νόον ’for as long as she holds this purpose’)
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg.; with γε: ’he’ · also relative, masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic: ’who’ (ὅ κε ... ἐφείη) · also = ὅτι ’that’; εἰς ὅ ’until’ · also relative, neut. nom./acc. sg.: ’which’ (ὅ οἱ πέρι δῶκεν Ἀθήνη ’which Athena gave her beyond others’)
ὅπλ: ὅπλον — tool, gear; pl. ship’s tackle and rigging (not weapons here); neut. acc. pl., elided (ὅπλ’ = ὅπλα)
ὑπέρτερα: ὑπέρτερος — higher, upper; neut. acc. pl., of meat: ’the upper (outer) flesh’
ὕδωρ: ὕδωρ — water; neut. acc. sg. · also nom. sg. (identical neut. form), subject of a verb (ἄνεμός τε καὶ ὕδωρ ‘wind and current’)
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως) · also postpositive after its noun (anastrophe), = comparative ὡς ’as, like’: ὄρνις δ’ ὥς ’like a bird’
ὤπτων: ὀπτάω — roast; impf. 3 pl.: ’they were roasting’
ὤρνυτ: ὄρνυμι — stir, rouse; impf. mid. 3 sg., elided (ὤρνυτ’ = ὤρνυτο): ’rose’
ῥ: ἄρα (weakened ῥα, elided ῥ’) — then, indeed, so; inferential particle
ῥοδοδάκτυλος: ῥοδοδάκτυλος — rose-fingered; fem. nom. sg., epithet of Dawn
